flawless: Every move you made, I had schemed three moves ahead of it. Ten, really.
I have outlived empires. You were a pleasant afternoon.
Enchantments are only plans made visible, and mine were flawless.
solid: You unravelled a few of my plans. I always keep a few more.
A clever opponent! I shall add you to my collection of contingencies.
close: You came within a thread of undoing me. I haven't felt that since the Ice Age thawed.
That was nearly the end of an eternal schemer. Imagine the embarrassment.
